jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview
 Visual Studio Code is where millions of developers turn ideas into working software. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer in Zurich to tackle hard product and platform challenges as VS Code and GitHub Copilot continue to reshape how developers build software.
 You will help to evolve VS Code as a market leading developer environment, seamlessly connecting its editor, agentic coding abilities, platform and extension ecosystem. You will identify where investment matters, prove difficult ideas in code, and establish approaches that multiple teams can build on. This is hands-on technical leadership: the opportunity to change both what developers can accomplish and what our engineering teams can deliver.

About the team
 We work in the open, with direct feedback from developers and extension authors. You will partner with engineers, designers, researchers, and product leaders across our team, GitHub, and Microsoft. We combine community feedback, research, experiments, and engineering judgment to decide what to build. Performance, accessibility, extensibility, security, and developer control are part of the product, not finishing touches.

Examples of work
 The role spans core VS Code and Copilot; illustrative projects include:

• Address architectural bottlenecks in large workspaces, proving an approach in code that multiple feature teams can adopt.

• Define extension or workspace APIs that unlock new capabilities while preserving compatibility with existing extensions and remote development environments.

• Prototype how developers delegate, review, and validate work with Copilot, then establish the product and platform boundaries needed to ship it.

• Reshape and support our engineering process with custom solutions fine-tuned for throughput and quality.

Responsibilities

• Identify significant product opportunities and systemic engineering problems; set technical direction that balances near-term delivery with long-term product and platform health.

• Prove approaches through prototypes, critical implementation, testing, and difficult debugging, using hands-on work to guide architectural decisions.

• Lead cross-team delivery across Microsoft and GitHub, resolving architectural disagreements, clarifying ownership and API boundaries, and enabling teams to deliver independently.

• Own outcomes beyond release, using adoption, quality signals, evaluations, experiments, and user feedback to guide investment and adjust course.

• Improve engineering effectiveness across teams through testing strategies, performance work, shared design patterns, and tools for rapid, reliable experimentation.

• Lead technical discussions in the open, investigate community-reported issues, and work directly with developers and extension authors to shape designs.

• Mentor experienced engineers and technical leaders, helping them develop judgment and take ownership without making yourself a bottleneck.

Qualifications
 Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

• Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams, including setting direction, building alignment, and delivering substantial initiatives without relying on reporting-line authority.

• Solid hands-on coding and design skills, with the ability to become productive in large TypeScript and Rust codebases.

• Experience designing shared platforms, APIs, or large application architectures, with sound judgment about extensibility, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.

• Solid product judgment, including identifying opportunities, setting priorities amid ambiguity, and turning technical decisions into practical designs and measurable improvements for users.

• A track record of mentoring experienced engineers and improving the effectiveness of teams beyond your immediate area.

• Clear communication skills, including explaining complex technical decisions and navigating tradeoffs with engineering and product partners.

Preferred Qualifications
 We welcome a range of product backgrounds; these are helpful experiences, not a checklist. Previous work on developer tools, open-source projects, or AI products is not required.

• Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

• Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript and Rust.

• Experience evolving interactive products with attention to usability and accessibility.

• Experience guiding cross-platform architecture, performance improvements, or major migrations in a large application.

• Experience establishing experimentation and feedback practices that connect engineering decisions to user outcomes.

• Practical familiarity with AI coding tools and sound judgment about where they help, where they fall short, and how they change development workflows.

• Experience providing technical leadership on AI-powered products, open-source projects, or extensible applications.

Product and open source
 https://code.visualstudio.com
 https://github.com/microsoft/vscode

Other requirements
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.  We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request via the  Accommodation request form .

Panoramica
Visual Studio Code è dove milioni di sviluppatori trasformano le idee in software di lavoro. Stiamo cercando un Principal Software Engineer a Zurigo per affrontare le sfide del prodotto duro e della piattaforma come VS Code e GitHub Copilot continuano a rimodellare come gli sviluppatori costruiscono software.
Ti aiuterà a evolvere VS Code come un ambiente sviluppatore leader di mercato, collegando senza soluzione di continuità il suo editor, le capacità di codifica agentec, piattaforma e ecosistema di estensione. Si identificherà dove le questioni di investimento, dimostrare idee difficili in codice, e stabilire approcci su cui più team possono costruire. Questa è la leadership tecnica pratica: l'opportunità di cambiare sia ciò che gli sviluppatori possono realizzare e ciò che i nostri team di ingegneria possono fornire.

Informazioni sulla squadra
Lavoriamo all'aperto, con feedback diretto da sviluppatori e autori di estensione. Potrai collaborare con ingegneri, progettisti, ricercatori e leader di prodotto in tutta la nostra squadra, GitHub e Microsoft. Uniamo feedback comunitario, ricerca, esperimenti e giudizio ingegneristico per decidere cosa costruire. Le prestazioni, l'accessibilità, l'estensibilità, la sicurezza e il controllo degli sviluppatori fanno parte del prodotto, non terminando i tocchi.

Esempi di lavoro
Il ruolo copre il core VS Code e Copilot; progetti illustrativi includono:

• Affronta le strozzature architettoniche in grandi spazi di lavoro, dimostrando un approccio in codice che più team di funzionalità possono adottare.

• Definire le API di estensione o workspace che sbloccano nuove funzionalità mantenendo la compatibilità con le estensioni esistenti e gli ambienti di sviluppo remoto.

• Prototipi come gli sviluppatori delegato, revisione e convalidare il lavoro con Copilot, quindi stabilire i confini del prodotto e della piattaforma necessari per spedirlo.

• Rimodellare e supportare il nostro processo di ingegneria con soluzioni personalizzate ottimizzate per il throughput e la qualità.

responsabilità

• Identificare significative opportunità di prodotto e problemi di ingegneria sistemica; impostare la direzione tecnica che bilancia la consegna a breve termine con la salute di prodotto e piattaforma a lungo termine.

• Prove approcci attraverso prototipi, implementazione critica, test e debugging difficile, utilizzando il lavoro pratico per guidare le decisioni architettoniche.

• Condurre la consegna cross-team attraverso Microsoft e GitHub, risolvere i disaccordi architettonici, chiarire la proprietà e i confini API, e consentire ai team di fornire indipendentemente.

• Risultati propri oltre il rilascio, utilizzando l'adozione, segnali di qualità, valutazioni, esperimenti e feedback degli utenti per guidare gli investimenti e regolare il corso.

• Migliorare l'efficacia dell'ingegneria attraverso le strategie di test, il lavoro di performance, i modelli di progettazione condivisi e gli strumenti per una sperimentazione rapida e affidabile.

• Svolgere discussioni tecniche all'aperto, indagare i problemi comunicati dalla comunità, e lavorare direttamente con sviluppatori e autori di estensione per modellare i disegni.

• Mentor ha sperimentato ingegneri e leader tecnici, aiutandoli a sviluppare il giudizio e prendere la proprietà senza rendersi un collo di bottiglia.

Qualifiche
Qualifiche di base

• Laurea in Informatica o relativo campo tecnico E 6+ anni esperienza tecnica di ingegneria con codifica in lingue tra cui, ma non solo, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, o Python OR esperienza equivalente.

• Dimostrata leadership tecnica in più squadre, tra cui l'impostazione della direzione, l'allineamento della costruzione, e la fornitura di iniziative sostanziali senza contare su autorità di reporting-line.

• Solido hands-on di codifica e abilità di progettazione, con la capacità di diventare produttivo in grandi codebase TypeScript e Rust.

• Esperienza nella progettazione di piattaforme condivise, API, o grandi architetture applicative, con giudizio sonoro su estensibilità, compatibilità, performance e manutenbilità.

• Giudizio solido dei prodotti, compreso l'individuazione delle opportunità, l'impostazione delle priorità in mezzo all'ambiguità, e la trasformazione delle decisioni tecniche in progetti pratici e miglioramenti misurabili per gli utenti.

• Un track record di mentoring esperti ingegneri e migliorare l'efficacia dei team oltre la vostra area immediata.

• Competenze di comunicazione chiare, tra cui la spiegazione di decisioni tecniche complesse e la navigazione di tradeoff con partner di ingegneria e prodotti.

Preferiti
Diamo il benvenuto a una gamma di background di prodotto; queste sono esperienze utili, non una lista di controllo. Il lavoro precedente su strumenti di sviluppo, progetti open source, o prodotti AI non è richiesto.

• Master's Degree in Computer Science o relativo campo tecnico E 8+ anni esperienza di ingegneria tecnica con codifica in lingue tra cui, ma non solo, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science o relativo campo tecnico E 12+ anni esperienza di ingegneria tecnica con codifica in lingue tra cui, ma non solo, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, o Python O equivalente esperienza.

• Esperienza con TypeScript, JavaScript e Rust.

• Esperienza di prodotti interattivi in evoluzione con attenzione all'usabilità e all'accessibilità.

• Esperienza che guida l'architettura cross-platform, miglioramenti delle prestazioni, o le migrazioni principali in una grande applicazione.

• Provate a stabilire pratiche di sperimentazione e feedback che collegano le decisioni di ingegneria ai risultati degli utenti.

• Pratica familiarità con gli strumenti di codifica AI e giudizio sonoro su dove aiutano, dove cadono breve, e come cambiano i flussi di lavoro di sviluppo.

• Esperienza che fornisce la leadership tecnica sui prodotti AI-powered, progetti open-source o applicazioni estensibili.

Aperçu général
Visual Studio Code est l'endroit où des millions de développeurs transforment des idées en logiciels de travail. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur principal de logiciels à Zurich pour relever les défis difficiles de produits et de plate-forme que VS Code et GitHub Copilot continuent à remodeler comment les développeurs construisent des logiciels.
Vous aiderez à faire évoluer VS Code en tant qu'environnement de développeur leader sur le marché, connectant parfaitement son éditeur, ses capacités de codage agentique, sa plateforme et son écosystème d'extension. Vous identifierez où l'investissement compte, prouverez des idées difficiles en code, et établirez des approches sur lesquelles plusieurs équipes peuvent s'appuyer. C'est un leadership technique pratique : l'occasion de changer à la fois ce que les développeurs peuvent accomplir et ce que nos équipes d'ingénierie peuvent offrir.

À propos de l'équipe
Nous travaillons en plein air, avec la rétroaction directe des développeurs et des auteurs d'extension. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des ingénieurs, des concepteurs, des chercheurs et des chefs de file dans notre équipe, GitHub et Microsoft. Nous combinons la rétroaction communautaire, la recherche, les expériences et le jugement d'ingénierie pour décider quoi construire. Performance, accessibilité, extensibilité, sécurité et contrôle des développeurs font partie du produit, et non des touches de finition.

Exemples de travaux
Le rôle s'étend au code VS de base et au copilote; les projets illustratifs comprennent :

• S'attaquer aux goulets d'étranglement architecturaux dans les grands espaces de travail, prouvant une approche codée que plusieurs équipes de fonctionnalités peuvent adopter.

• Définir des API d'extension ou d'espace de travail qui débloquent de nouvelles capacités tout en préservant la compatibilité avec les extensions existantes et les environnements de développement à distance.

• Prototyper comment les développeurs délèguent, examinent et valident le travail avec Copilot, puis établir les limites du produit et de la plate-forme nécessaires pour l'expédier.

• Remodeler et soutenir notre processus d'ingénierie avec des solutions personnalisées adaptées au débit et à la qualité.

Responsabilités

• Déterminer les possibilités importantes de produits et les problèmes d'ingénierie systémique; établir une orientation technique qui équilibre la prestation à court terme avec la santé à long terme des produits et des plateformes.

• Prouvez des approches au moyen de prototypes, de mise en oeuvre critique, de tests et de débogage difficile, en utilisant des travaux pratiques pour guider les décisions architecturales.

• Diriger la livraison entre équipes à travers Microsoft et GitHub, résoudre les désaccords architecturaux, clarifier les limites de propriété et d'API, et permettre aux équipes de livrer indépendamment.

• Résultats au-delà de la diffusion, en utilisant l'adoption, les signaux de qualité, les évaluations, les expériences et la rétroaction des utilisateurs pour guider l'investissement et ajuster le cours.

• Améliorer l'efficacité de l'ingénierie entre les équipes par des stratégies d'essai, des travaux de performance, des modèles de conception partagés et des outils pour une expérimentation rapide et fiable.

• Diriger les discussions techniques en public, étudier les problèmes signalés par la communauté, et travailler directement avec les développeurs et les auteurs d'extensions pour façonner les conceptions.

• Mentor a expérimenté les ingénieurs et les leaders techniques, les aidant à développer leur jugement et à s'approprier sans se faire un goulot d'étranglement.

Compétences
Qualités de base

• Baccalauréat en informatique ou domaine technique connexe ET 6+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie technique avec le codage en langues, y compris, mais non limité à, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, ou Python OR expérience équivalente.

• Le leadership technique démontré dans plusieurs équipes, y compris l'orientation, l'harmonisation et la réalisation d'initiatives importantes sans compter sur l'autorité hiérarchique.

• Des compétences de codage et de conception pratiques solides, avec la capacité de devenir productif dans les grandes bases de code TypeScript et Rust.

• Expérience de conception de plates-formes partagées, d'API ou de grandes architectures d'application, avec un jugement solide sur l'extensibilité, la compatibilité, la performance et la maintenance.

• Un jugement solide sur les produits, y compris l'identification des possibilités, l'établissement des priorités au milieu de l'ambiguïté et la transformation des décisions techniques en conceptions pratiques et en améliorations mesurables pour les utilisateurs.

• Une expérience de mentorat d'ingénieurs expérimentés et d'amélioration de l'efficacité des équipes au-delà de votre zone immédiate.

• Compétences claires en communication, y compris l'explication de décisions techniques complexes et la navigation des compromis avec les partenaires de l'ingénierie et des produits.

 With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.
 Imagine helping some of Switzerland's leading organizations change how work gets done, with an impact that reaches across industries, communities and lives worldwide. As a Cloud Solution Architect for Copilot and Agents, you will do exactly that with Microsoft 365 Copilot, agents and artificial intelligence.
 You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to turn modern cloud and AI capabilities into real-world scenarios that drive innovation and measurable value. Your role sits where strategy meets execution. You will shape how customers adopt, scale and govern AI as part of their digital transformation.
 You will combine your understanding of customer goals, market trends and Microsoft cloud architectures to guide organizations from first experiments to lasting transformation. You will help customers:

• Find the use cases that matter most

• Design adoption approaches that work for their people

• Remove the blockers that slow them down
 The result is measurable productivity gains and better business outcomes.
 Your impact goes beyond a single engagement. You will work across Microsoft and bring customer feedback to the product teams that shape the platform. You will also contribute to best-practice guidance and reusable patterns that help many more customers succeed.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

• Focus on customer and partner experience through efficient delivery, ensuring a seamless and connected engagement that supports value realization, improved satisfaction, and acceleration of transformation.

• Contribute to identifying, escalating, and mitigating technical and business blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, usage, and business outcome realization.

• Help customers adopt and use solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy by translating business problems into industry solutions, explaining the business value and return on investment.

• Collaborate across Microsoft and customer or partner teams to deliver on-strategy engagements, manage business and technical risks in line with governance principles, and ensure work complies with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures.

• Finden Sie die Anwendungsfälle, die am wichtigsten sind

• Design Adoption Ansätze, die für ihre Menschen arbeiten

• Entfernen Sie die Blocker, die sie verlangsamen
Das Ergebnis sind messbare Produktivitätsgewinne und bessere Geschäftsergebnisse.
Ihre Wirkung geht über ein einzelnes Engagement hinaus. Sie arbeiten über Microsoft und bringen Kundenfeedback zu den Produktteams, die die Plattform formen. Sie werden auch zu Best-Practice-Anleitungen und wiederverwendbaren Mustern beitragen, die vielen weiteren Kunden zum Erfolg verhelfen.

• OR equivalent experience

• Demonstrable experience in cloud infrastructure, including migration of workloads such as Windows, Linux, and VMs.

• Proven ability to lead technical engagements (e.g., prototyping, pilots, and PoCs) that drive production-scale outcomes.

• Demonstrable technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience
• OR equivalent experience

• Experience supporting system organizations, International Government Organizations, multilateral development banks or other public sector and mission-driven organizations.

• Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, and ISVs like NetApp, VMware, and Red Hat.
